rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for a place where people pitch tents and stay overnight.

example.english: We're staying overnight at the campsite tonight, so we don't need to walk any farther.
example.traditional: 我哋今晚喺營地過夜，唔使再行喇。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 gam1 maan5 hai2 jing4 dei6 gwo3 je6 m4 sai2 zoi3 haang4 laa3

rows.note: Use this when referring specifically to a designated camping ground or facility.

example.english: This campsite even has shower facilities.
example.traditional: 呢個露營場地有埋沖涼設施。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 lou6 jing4 coeng4 dei6 jau5 maai4 cung1 loeng4 cit3 si1
